title: Membrane signalling and nuclear output
scope: Illustrative teaching model. L, R, A and TF are generic entities; the event order and durations are pedagogical.

events.title: Ligand binding
events.caption: L approaches R. Its label moves with the same component.

events.title: A changes state
events.caption: A changes state downstream of R; an activation arrow does not imply physical docking.

events.title: Phosphorylation marker
events.caption: The separate P badge identifies the illustrated modification.

events.title: TF enters the nucleus
events.caption: TF and its name travel together through the visible nuclear opening.

events.title: RNA output
events.caption: RNA appears as the final output. Pause here to explain the result.
